# Ankit Sikder — Interaction & UI/UX Designer

> Portfolio of Ankit Sikder, an interaction, UI/UX and product designer pursuing a Masters (M.Des) in Interaction Design at PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur, with a Bachelor's from the Institute of Design, Nirma University. Work spans enterprise UX, VR and spatial interaction, and physical product design.

## Case studies

- [Jio-bp Incident Management System](https://www.ankidesigns.in/work/jio-bp): Redesign of an enterprise incident management system into a role-based safety ecosystem — heuristic and competitor analysis, stakeholder role mapping, information architecture, design system, dashboards and mobile app.
- [Immersive Traffic Command](https://www.ankidesigns.in/work/vrtraffic): VR training simulator where traffic personnel practise hand signals, traffic coordination and high-pressure decision-making.
- [Makhana Seed Collection Tool](https://www.ankidesigns.in/work/makhana-tool): Ergonomic hand-tool concept for makhana (fox nut) harvesting that reduces awkward postures, thorn exposure and repetitive effort.
- [Aura Charge Smart Inverter](https://www.ankidesigns.in/work/auracharge): Product concept that turns home power backup into a smart energy hub with device charging and smart home features.
